covers:
**Prerequisite:** Ice Sphere and either Body Refining or Constitution 13+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Ice Source CL for Ice effects; Body Refining Source CL for Sure Foot on Winter.

Whenever an Ice feature grants you Temporary Hit Points, increase that grant by your Proficiency Bonus. Apply this increase once per activation, not once per target or round.

**Sure Foot on Winter — Once per scene:** When you would be knocked Prone while standing on ice, snow, or your Frost Lattice, choose not to become Prone. This does not prevent forced movement or damage unless those effects depend entirely on becoming Prone.
insight.winter-tempered-body.why: Printed Ice combat clauses resolved by sealed ice_second_pass hooks; ability-score selection stays in the character build.

covers:
#### Palace Where Footsteps Become Walls
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Ice Domain: Palace of Written Winter
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: A hostile creature in your Ice Domain moves at least 10 feet
Cost: 2 CP
After the movement resolves, create a number of Glacier Wall panels equal to your Proficiency Bonus along spaces the creature moved through or adjacent to those spaces. These panels last until the start of your next turn and do not cost additional CP.
The panels cannot appear in occupied spaces, but they may split groups, block retreat, seal doors, divide lines of sight, or create cover.
TAL_ICE_PALACE_WHERE_FOOTSTEPS_BECOME_WA.why: Post-movement hostile Domain trigger; optional 2 CP, PB native defended panels with start-of-next-turn expiry.
